nodes.summary: Let $E$ and $F$ be inner product spaces over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and let $T : E \to F$ be a bounded linear operator. Then the restriction of $T$ to the orthogonal complement $(\ker T)^\perp$ of its kernel is injective: a vector lying in both $\ker T$ and $(\ker T)^\perp$ is zero.
nodes.title: Restriction to the orthogonal complement of the kernel is injective

nodes.summary: Let $E$ and $F$ be Hilbert spaces over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and let $T : E \to F$ be a bounded linear operator with adjoint $T^\dagger$. Then the range of $T$ is closed in $F$ if and only if the range of $T^\dagger$ is closed in $E$.
nodes.title: Closed range theorem for adjoints

nodes.summary: Let $X$ and $Y$ be complex Hilbert spaces and let $A : X \to Y$ be a bounded linear operator with Hilbert space adjoint $A^* : Y \to X$. If the range of $A$ is closed in $Y$, then the range of $A^*$ is closed in $X$.
nodes.title: Closed range passes to the Hilbert space adjoint

nodes.summary: Let $E$ and $F$ be Hilbert spaces over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and let $T : E \to F$ be a bounded linear operator with adjoint $T^\dagger$. If the range of $T$ is closed in $F$, then the range of $T^\dagger$ is closed in $E$.
nodes.title: Closed range passes to the adjoint

nodes.summary: Closed range from a Fredholm $T^*T$. Let $X$ and $Y$ be complex Hilbert spaces and let $T : X \to Y$ be a bounded linear operator with Hilbert space adjoint $T^* : Y \to X$. If $T^*T : X \to X$ is a Fredholm operator, then the range of $T$ is closed in $Y$.
nodes.title: Closed range from a Fredholm $T^*T$

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a Hilbert space and $F$ an inner product space over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and let $T : E \to F$ be a bounded linear operator. Then the restriction of $T$ to the orthogonal complement $(\ker T)^\perp$ of its kernel has the same range as $T$: every value $T x$ is attained at the orthogonal projection of $x$ onto $(\ker T)^\perp$, since the difference lies in…
nodes.title: Restriction to the orthogonal complement of the kernel keeps the range

nodes.summary: Let $E'$ and $F'$ be Hilbert spaces over $\mathbb{K}$, where $\mathbb{K}$ is $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and let $S : E' \to F'$ be a bounded linear operator. The set of values of $S$ equals the underlying set of the range of $S$ regarded as a linear subspace of $F'$.
nodes.title: The range of a bounded operator as a set

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
